query getTaxInformation($input: GetTaxInformationInput!) {
  getTaxInformation(input: $input) {
    year
    ownership
    fortune
    costs
    debt
    ownershipFrom
    ownershipTo
    lastUpdated
    income
    propertyValue
    transfer
    remarks
    birthdate
    organisationNumber
  }
}

query vibboGroup($organizationSlug: OrganizationID!, $groupSlug: String!, $withMembers: Boolean = false, $limit: Int, $after: NodeID) {
  vibboGroup(organizationId: $organizationSlug, groupSlug: $groupSlug) {
    id
    name
    description
    slug
    imageUrl
    imageId
    isPrivateGroup
    type
    memberCount
    updatedAt
    createdAt
    createdBy {
      id
      userId
      name
      profilePhotoUrl
      jobTitle
    }
    posts(limit: $limit, after: $after) {
      id
      body
      slug
      publishedAt
      createdAt
      updatedAt
      deletedAt
      createdBy {
        id
        userId
        name
        profilePhotoUrl
        jobTitle
      }
      attachments {
        id
        url
        filename
        contentType
        meta {
          width
          height
          fileSize
        }
      }
      commentsCount
      ...SocialReactableListItem
    }
    postCount
    viewerIsMember
    viewerIsAdmin
    viewerAsGroupMember {
      id
      userId
      name
      profilePhotoUrl
      admin
      isBoardMemberOrEmployee
      listOfOrganizations
    }
    adminCount
    members @include(if: $withMembers) {
      id
      userId
      name
      profilePhotoUrl
      admin
      isBoardMemberOrEmployee
      listOfOrganizations
    }
    organization {
      isCluster
      id
      name
    }
  }
}
fragment SocialReactableListItem on SocialReactable {
  id
  __typename
  reactionCount(type: THUMBS_UP)
  viewerReactions
}

query vibboMyApartmentPage($organizationSlug: OrganizationID!) {
  organization(id: $organizationSlug) {
    id
    organizationCode
    obosCompanyNumber
    organizationNumber
    onProperty
    pendingApplications(boardPerspective: false) {
      ...ResidentApplication
    }
    viewerAsMember {
      id
      personId
      name
      residencies {
        id
        type
        legalOwnerName
        apartment {
          id
          apartmentNumber
          apartmentType
          unitNumber
          residentialNumber
          rented
          sharedOwnership
          address
          postalCode
          city
          doorway
          objectType
          requiresBruksoverlating
          transferApplications {
            ...TransferApplication
          }
          transferApplicationChanges {
            ...TransferApplicationChange
          }
          contract {
            ...ContractOptions
          }
          residencies {
            id
            bruksoverlating
            contractStart
            contractEnd
            type
            legalOwnerName
            fromVibbo
            resident {
              ...ApartmentResident
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
fragment ResidentApplication on ResidentApplication {
  id
  name
  firstName
  lastName
  phoneNumber
  email
  role
  viewerCanApprove
  comment
  apartmentNumber
  reminderWasSent
  sentForManualHandling
  invitedByOwner
  needsApartmentSelection
}
fragment TransferApplication on TransferApplication {
  id
  createdBy {
    id
    firstName
    lastName
    profilePhotoUrl
    email
    phoneNumber
    userId
    organizationNumber
  }
  createdAt
  apartmentNumber
  decidedAt
  decidedBy {
    id
  }
  tenantFirstName
  tenantLastName
  tenantPhoneNumber
  tenantEmail
  tenantBirthDate
  numberOfResidents
  numberOfPets
  contractFrom
  contractTo
  rejectionReason
  isTenantFamily
  hasSelfOrFamilyResided
  description
  status
  housingObject {
    id
    address
    postalCode
    city
    apartmentNumber
    unitNumber
    residentialNumber
    contract {
      contractEnd
    }
  }
  settings {
    viewerCanApprove
    viewerCanReject
    viewerCanCancel
  }
}
fragment TransferApplicationChange on TransferApplicationChange {
  id
  type
  createdBy {
    id
    firstName
    lastName
    profilePhotoUrl
    email
    phoneNumber
    userId
    organizationNumber
  }
  createdAt
  apartmentNumber
  decidedAt
  decidedBy {
    id
  }
  tenantFirstName
  tenantLastName
  previousTenantFirstName
  previousTenantLastName
  previousContractTo
  tenantPhoneNumber
  tenantEmail
  tenantBirthDate
  numberOfResidents
  numberOfPets
  contractFrom
  contractTo
  rejectionReason
  isTenantFamily
  hasSelfOrFamilyResided
  description
  status
  housingObject {
    id
    address
    postalCode
    city
    apartmentNumber
    unitNumber
    residentialNumber
    contract {
      contractEnd
    }
  }
  settings {
    viewerCanApprove

fragment ContractOptions on HousingObjectContract {
  viewerCanRegisterTransferApplication
  viewerCanExtendContract
  viewerCanChangeContract
  viewerCanTerminateContract
  contractEnd
  contractStart
  hasTransferApplication
}
fragment ApartmentResident on Member {
  id
  userId
  personId
  firstName
  lastName
  phoneNumber
  email
}

query vibboResidentAdministrationPage($organizationSlug: OrganizationID!) {
  organization(id: $organizationSlug) {
    id
    slug
    name
    obosCompanyNumber
    organizationCode
    statistics {
      id
      buildings {
        id
        apartmentsCount
      }
    }
    invitation {
      invitationSentAt
      invitationSentBy {
        id
        name
      }
    }
    addresses {
      address
    }
    residents {
      id
      userId
      personId
      firstName
      lastName
      name
      profilePhotoUrl
      permissions
      primaryResidentType
      residencies {
        id
        bruksoverlating
        type
        legalOwnerName
        contractStart
        contractEnd
        resident {
          ...ApartmentResident
        }
        apartment {
          id
          objectType
          requiresBruksoverlating
          hasAnonymousManager
          apartmentNumber
          residentialNumber
          unitNumber
          doorway
          address
          city
          postalCode
          apartmentType
        }
      }
    }
    pendingApplications(boardPerspective: true) {
      id
      createdAt
      name
      firstName
      lastName
      phoneNumber
      email
      comment
      reminderWasSent
      apartmentNumber
      viewerCanApprove
      invitedByOwner
      sentForManualHandling
      role
      owner {
        id
        name
        phoneNumber
        residenciesWithTypeOwner: residencies(type: [OWNER]) {
          id
          apartment {
            id
            objectType
            unitNumber
            residentialNumber
            doorway
            requiresBruksoverlating
            hasAnonymousManager
            apartmentNumber
            address
          }
        }
      }
    }
    transferApplications {
      ...TransferApplication
    }
    transferApplicationChanges {
      ...TransferApplicationChange
    }
  }
}

  firstName

  phoneNumber

}

query vibboUserWithOrganizationContextQuery($organizationSlug: OrganizationID!) {
    version

    viewer {
      id # Used by Google Analytics
      personId
      name
      firstName
      sub
      profilePhotoUrl
      flags
      organizationFlags(organizationId: $organizationSlug)
      admin
      isKioskAdmin
      isHousingManager
      phoneNumber

      notifications(showInStyrerommet: false, showInVibbo: true) {
        id
        title
        message
        type
      }

      pendingInvitations {
        id
        viewerCanApprove
        organization {
          id
          obosCompanyNumber
        }
      }
    }

    organization(id: $organizationSlug) {
      # Be careful not to add too much bloat here, as this data will ALWAYS be queried
      id
      apartmentsCount
      vibboEnabled
      name
      onProperty
      hasCluster
      hasActiveCalendars
      slug
      obosCompanyNumber
      intendedForTest
      status
      requiresBruksoverlating
      organizationCode
      clusters {
        id
        name
        slug
        organizations(skipMembership: true) {
          id
          name
        }
      }
      modulesAvailable

      viewerAsMember {
        id
        email
        permissions
        electronicConsent
        roles
        visibleRoleNames
      }
    }
  }
